import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static int MAXN = 300;
    static int MAXE = 50000;
    static int[] to = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] cap = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] nxt = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int arcCnt;

    static int S, T;
    static int[] distTo = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] curArc = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] gapCnt = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] inQueue = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] parentNode = new int[MAXN];

    static void add_arc(int u, int v, int w) {
        to[arcCnt] = v; cap[arcCnt] = w; nxt[arcCnt] = head[u]; head[u] = arcCnt++;
        to[arcCnt] = u; cap[arcCnt] = 0; nxt[arcCnt] = head[v]; head[v] = arcCnt++;
    }

    static int max_flow(int src, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(curArc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(parentNode, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, 0);
        Arrays.fill(distTo, 0);
        Arrays.fill(gapCnt, 0);

        Queue<Integer> que = new LinkedList<>();
        que.add(sink);
        inQueue[sink] = 1;
        gapCnt[0]++;
        distTo[sink] = 0;

        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            int u = que.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                int v = to[i];
                if (inQueue[v] == 0) {
                    inQueue[v] = 1;
                    que.add(v);
                    distTo[v] = distTo[u] + 1;
                    gapCnt[distTo[v]]++;
                    curArc[v] = head[v];
                }
            }
        }

        int low = INF, u = src, ans = 0;
        parentNode[src] = src;

        while (distTo[src] < sink) {
            boolean advanced = false;
            int i = curArc[u];
            while (i != -1) {
                if (cap[i] > 0 && distTo[to[i]] + 1 == distTo[u]) {
                    advanced = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, cap[i]);
                    parentNode[to[i]] = u;
                    curArc[u] = i;
                    u = to[i];
                    if (u == sink) {
                        while (u != src) {
                            u = parentNode[u];
                            cap[curArc[u]] -= low;
                            cap[curArc[u] ^ 1] += low;
                        }
                        ans += low;
                        low = INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
                i = nxt[i];
                curArc[u] = i;
            }
            if (advanced) continue;

            int mindis = sink + 1;
            for (int j = head[u]; j != -1; j = nxt[j]) {
                if (cap[j] > 0 && mindis > distTo[to[j]]) {
                    mindis = distTo[to[j]];
                    curArc[u] = j;
                }
            }
            gapCnt[distTo[u]]--;
            if (gapCnt[distTo[u]] == 0) return ans;
            distTo[u] = mindis + 1;
            gapCnt[distTo[u]]++;
            u = parentNode[u];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static char[][] gridA, gridB;
    static int[][] startCnt, endNeed;
    static int[][][] stones;
    static int[][][][][] reachable;
    static int[][] seen;
    static int[][] moves = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, timeLimit;

    static void expandStones() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= timeLimit; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (stones[k-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        stones[k][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (stones[k-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        stones[k][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
                            int nx = i + moves[z][0];
                            int ny = j + moves[z][1];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n) {
                                if (stones[k-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                    stones[k][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void walk(int sx, int sy, int x, int y, int k) {
        seen[x][y] = 1;
        reachable[k][sx][sy][x][y] = 1;
        if (k >= timeLimit || stones[k][x][y] != 0) return;
        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
            int nx = x + moves[z][0];
            int ny = y + moves[z][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && seen[nx][ny] == 0) {
                if (stones[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                walk(sx, sy, nx, ny, k + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        gridA = new char[n+2][n+2];
        gridB = new char[n+2][n+2];
        startCnt = new int[n+2][n+2];
        endNeed = new int[n+2][n+2];
        stones = new int[timeLimit+1][n+2][n+2];
        reachable = new int[timeLimit+1][n+2][n+2][n+2][n+2];
        seen = new int[n+2][n+2];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') stones[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (gridA[i][j] == 'Y') stones[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9')
                    startCnt[i][j] = gridA[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (gridB[i][j] >= '0' && gridB[i][j] <= '9')
                    endNeed[i][j] = gridB[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        expandStones();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (startCnt[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; ++a) Arrays.fill(seen[a], 0);
                    walk(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 1; k <= timeLimit; ++k) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                            reachable[k][x][y][nx][ny] += reachable[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        S = 0;
        T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        arcCnt = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                add_arc(S, (i-1)*n + j, startCnt[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                add_arc(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, T, endNeed[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                        if (startCnt[x][y] > 0 && endNeed[nx][ny] > 0) {
                            if (reachable[timeLimit][x][y][nx][ny] > 0)
                                add_arc((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = max_flow(S, T);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
